 Recusal
 On: 2026-05-06
I recused myself from: Discussion, Decision
Regarding: Recusal from decision-making with respect to disability benefits for a veteran due to a personal relationship with that veteran
In the exercise of my official duties as a member of the Veterans Review and Appeal Board, I recused myself on May 5, 2026, from a discussion or decision regarding a scheduled hearing to determine if a veteran is entitled to benefits for a claimed service-related injury or disease, in order to avoid any conflict of interest between my official functions and the private interest of that veteran, a former instructor and supervisor.
 In the exercise of my official duties as a member of the Veterans Review and Appeal Board, I recused myself on December 16, 2025, from a discussion and decision regarding a scheduled hearing to determine if a veteran is entitled to benefits for a claimed service-related injury or disease, in order to avoid any conflict of interest between my official functions and the private interest of that veteran, a former direct subordinate.
